name: sum_map_theClosedSix_add_compl
statement:
theorem sum_map_theClosedSix_add_compl (s : Set X) :
    ((theClosedSix s).map fun t ↦ {t} + {tᶜ}).sum = theClosedSix s + theOpenSix s
proof:
:=
  Multiset.sum_map_add

name: theFourteen_eq_pair_add_theClosedSix_add_theOpenSix
statement:
theorem theFourteen_eq_pair_add_theClosedSix_add_theOpenSix (s : Set X) :
    theFourteen s = {s, sᶜ} + theClosedSix s + theOpenSix s
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_assoc, ← sum_map_theClosedSix_add_compl]; rfl

name: isClosed_of_mem_theClosedSix
statement: theorem isClosed_of_mem_theClosedSix (h : t ∈ theClosedSix s) : IsClosed t
proof:
:= by
  repeat obtain _ | ⟨_, h⟩ := h; rotate_left
  all_goals exact isClosed_closure

name: isOpen_of_mem_theOpenSix
statement: theorem isOpen_of_mem_theOpenSix (h : t ∈ theOpenSix s) : IsOpen t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp h
  exact (isClosed_of_mem_theClosedSix ht).isOpen_compl

name: mem_theOpenSix_iff
statement: theorem mem_theOpenSix_iff : t ∈ theOpenSix s ↔ tᶜ ∈ theClosedSix s
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [theOpenSix, ← compl_compl t, Multiset.mem_map_of_injective compl_injective]

name: nodup_theClosedSix_theFourteen_iff
statement: theorem nodup_theClosedSix_theFourteen_iff : (theClosedSix s).Nodup ↔ TheSixIneq s
proof:
:= by
  rw [TheSixIneq, theClosedSix]
  simp only [insert_eq_cons, nodup_cons, mem_cons, mem_singleton,
             not_or, nodup_singleton, and_true, ← ne_eq, and_assoc]
  
  constructor 
  · 
    tauto
  · intro h 
    repeat obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := h 
    repeat refine .symm (.intro ?_ ?_) 
    any_goals
      rw [ne_comm]
      try assumption
    
    any_goals
    /- Now eight other goals can be solved by simplifying
      and then using one of the six given inequalities. -/
      apply mt (congr_arg (k ·ᶜ))
      first
      | try repeat rw [kckckck_eq_kck, eq_comm]
        assumption
      | apply mt (congr_arg (k ·ᶜ))
        try repeat rw [kckckck_eq_kck, eq_comm]
        assumption
    
    · apply mt (congr_arg fun s ↦ k (k sᶜ)ᶜ)
      rwa [kckckck_eq_kck]

name: nodup_theFourteen_of_nodup_theClosedSix_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem nodup_theFourteen_of_nodup_theClosedSix_of_disjoint
    (nodup : (theClosedSix s).Nodup) (disj : Disjoint (theClosedSix s) (theOpenSix s)) :
    (theFourteen s).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [theFourteen_eq_pair_add_theClosedSix_add_theOpenSix, add_assoc, nodup_add, nodup_add]
  refine ⟨?_, ⟨nodup, nodup.map compl_injective, disj⟩, ?_⟩
  
  · 
    have : Nontrivial (Set X) := ⟨_, _, (List.pairwise_cons.mp nodup).1 _ (.head _)⟩
    simp
  have hs : ¬ IsClosed s := fun h ↦ by simp [theClosedSix] at nodup
  have hsc : ¬ IsClosed sᶜ := fun h ↦ by simp [theClosedSix] at nodup
  
  simp only [insert_eq_cons, disjoint_add_right, disjoint_cons_left, singleton_disjoint,
    mem_theOpenSix_iff, compl_compl, and_comm, and_self]
  exact ⟨(hs <| isClosed_of_mem_theClosedSix ·), (hsc <| isClosed_of_mem_theClosedSix ·)⟩

name: k_Icc_4_5_inter_rat
statement: theorem k_Icc_4_5_inter_rat : k (Icc (4 : ℝ) 5 ∩ range Rat.cast) = Icc 4 5
proof:
:=
  (closure_ordConnected_inter_rat ordConnected_Icc ⟨4, by norm_num, 5, by norm_num⟩).trans
    isClosed_Icc.closure_eq

name: i_fourteenSet
statement: theorem i_fourteenSet : i fourteenSet = Ioo 0 1 ∪ Ioo 1 2
proof:
:= by
  have := interior_eq_empty_iff_dense_compl.mpr dense_irrational
  rw [fourteenSet, interior_union_of_disjoint_closure, interior_union_of_disjoint_closure]
  · simp [(isOpen_Ioo.union isOpen_Ioo).interior_eq, this]
  all_goals
  · simp [k_Icc_4_5_inter_rat, -union_singleton, closure_union, disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty,
      union_inter_distrib_right, Icc_inter_Icc]
    norm_num

name: k_fourteenSet
statement: theorem k_fourteenSet : k fourteenSet = Icc 0 2 ∪ {3} ∪ Icc 4 5
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [fourteenSet, closure_union]
  rw [closure_Ioo, closure_Ioo, k_Icc_4_5_inter_rat, Icc_union_Icc'] <;> simp

name: kc_fourteenSet
statement: theorem kc_fourteenSet : k fourteenSetᶜ = (Ioo 0 1 ∪ Ioo 1 2)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [closure_compl, compl_inj_iff, i_fourteenSet]

name: kck_fourteenSet
statement: theorem kck_fourteenSet : k (k fourteenSet)ᶜ = (Ioo 0 2 ∪ Ioo 4 5)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [closure_compl, k_fourteenSet,
    interior_union_of_disjoint_closure, interior_union_of_disjoint_closure]
  all_goals
     simp [-union_singleton, disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, union_inter_distrib_right, Icc_inter_Icc]
  all_goals norm_num

name: kckc_fourteenSet
statement: theorem kckc_fourteenSet : k (k fourteenSetᶜ)ᶜ = Icc 0 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [kc_fourteenSet, compl_compl, closure_union, closure_Ioo, closure_Ioo]
  all_goals norm_num

name: kckck_fourteenSet
statement: theorem kckck_fourteenSet : k (k (k fourteenSet)ᶜ)ᶜ = Icc 0 2 ∪ Icc 4 5
proof:
:= by
  rw [kck_fourteenSet, compl_compl, closure_union, closure_Ioo, closure_Ioo]
  all_goals norm_num

name: kckckc_fourteenSet
statement: theorem kckckc_fourteenSet : k (k (k fourteenSetᶜ)ᶜ)ᶜ = (Ioo 0 2)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [kckc_fourteenSet, closure_compl, interior_Icc]

name: nodup_theClosedSix_fourteenSet
statement: theorem nodup_theClosedSix_fourteenSet : (theClosedSix fourteenSet).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [nodup_theClosedSix_theFourteen_iff, TheSixIneq, kckckc_fourteenSet, kckck_fourteenSet,
    kckc_fourteenSet, kck_fourteenSet, kc_fourteenSet, k_fourteenSet]
  refine ⟨(ne_of_mem_of_not_mem' (a := 1) ?_ ?_).symm,
    (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem' (a := 1) ?_ ?_).symm,
    ne_of_mem_of_not_mem' (a := 4.5) ?_ ?_,
    (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem' (a := 1) ?_ ?_).symm,
    ne_of_mem_of_not_mem' (a := 1) ?_ ?_,
    (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem' (a := 3) ?_ ?_).symm⟩
  all_goals norm_num

name: nonempty_of_mem_theClosedSix_fourteenSet
statement:
theorem nonempty_of_mem_theClosedSix_fourteenSet {s}
    (h : s ∈ theClosedSix fourteenSet) : s.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [theClosedSix, kckckc_fourteenSet, kckck_fourteenSet,
    kckc_fourteenSet, kck_fourteenSet, kc_fourteenSet, k_fourteenSet] at h
  repeat obtain _ | ⟨_, h⟩ := h; rotate_left
  all_goals use 2; norm_num

name: not_eq_univ_of_mem_theClosedSix_fourteenSet
statement:
theorem not_eq_univ_of_mem_theClosedSix_fourteenSet {s}
    (h : s ∈ theClosedSix fourteenSet) : s ≠ univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [theClosedSix, kckckc_fourteenSet, kckck_fourteenSet,
    kckc_fourteenSet, kck_fourteenSet, kc_fourteenSet, k_fourteenSet] at h
  rw [Ne, eq_univ_iff_forall]
  push Not
  repeat obtain _ | ⟨_, h⟩ := h; rotate_left
  · use 1 / 2; norm_num
  · use 1 / 2; norm_num
  · use 6; norm_num
  · use 6; norm_num
  · use 1 / 2; norm_num
  · use 6; norm_num

name: nodup_theFourteen_fourteenSet
statement: theorem nodup_theFourteen_fourteenSet : (theFourteen fourteenSet).Nodup
proof:
:=
  nodup_theFourteen_of_nodup_theClosedSix_of_disjoint nodup_theClosedSix_fourteenSet <|
    Multiset.disjoint_iff_ne.mpr <| by
      rintro s hc _ ho rfl
      exact not_eq_univ_of_mem_theClosedSix_fourteenSet hc <| IsClopen.eq_univ
        ⟨isClosed_of_mem_theClosedSix hc, isOpen_of_mem_theOpenSix ho⟩
        (nonempty_of_mem_theClosedSix_fourteenSet hc)

name: ncard_isObtainable_fourteenSet
statement: theorem ncard_isObtainable_fourteenSet : {t | IsObtainable fourteenSet t}.ncard = 14
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_theFourteen fourteenSet, ← Multiset.toFinset_card_of_nodup
    nodup_theFourteen_fourteenSet, ← Set.ncard_coe_finset]
  congr; ext; simp [mem_theFourteen_iff_isObtainable]

name: eval_lit
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_lit : (lit b).eval f = b
proof: := rfl

name: eval_var
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_var : (var i).eval f = f i
proof: := rfl

name: eval_ite_lit
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_ite_lit :
    (ite (.lit b) t e).eval f = bif b then t.eval f else e.eval f
proof: := rfl

name: eval_ite_var
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_ite_var :
    (ite (.var i) t e).eval f = bif f i then t.eval f else e.eval f
proof: := rfl

name: eval_ite_ite
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_ite_ite {a b c d e : IfExpr} :
    (ite (ite a b c) d e).eval f = (ite a (ite b d e) (ite c d e)).eval f
proof:
:= by
  cases h : eval f a <;> simp_all [eval]

name: eval_ite_ite'
statement:
theorem eval_ite_ite' {a b c d e : IfExpr} {f : ℕ → Bool} :
    (ite (ite a b c) d e).eval f = (ite a (ite b d e) (ite c d e)).eval f
proof:
:= by
  cases h : eval f a <;> simp_all
